tasks.title: Server entry point and in-memory book store
tasks.goal: Set up HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 with PORT env (default 8000) and a thread-safe BookStore with auto-incrementing integer ids.

tasks.title: Request parsing and body validation for POST
tasks.goal: Parse JSON request bodies, validate required/optional fields and types, reject id in body, and reject invalid/missing fields with 400 responses.

tasks.title: GET and PUT handlers with path id validation
tasks.goal: Implement GET /books/{id} and PUT /books/{id} endpoints, validating non-integer path ids, replacing book fields on PUT, and returning 404 for nonexistent books.

tasks.title: GET list with filtering and unknown query param handling
tasks.goal: Implement GET /books listing all books ordered by id, supporting field-level and q= search filters, rejecting unknown query parameters with 400.

tasks.title: DELETE endpoint integration
tasks.goal: Implement DELETE /books/{id} endpoint to remove a book and respond 204, returning 404 for nonexistent books.
